nom: Acure Brightening Facial Scrub - Exfoliating Face Wash - 4 fl oz

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who also describes it as combination and prone to breakouts, report the scrub has helped manage breakouts over time, though one says it leaves a slightly moisturized after-feel rather than the squeaky-clean finish she wanted.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are divided: some with dry, flaky skin find the exfoliating particles too large and sharp and feel the product strips the skin, while others with dry or dead-skin buildup, including occasional winter dryness, say the abrasion is well-judged and does not damage or over-dry their skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including skin that swings between oily and dry, report the scrub keeps their skin clearer and brighter without over-drying it, with no flakiness or redness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or acne-prone skin, several describing it as very or extremely sensitive, report no irritation and calmer-looking, less red skin, though a couple of reviewers caution the grit may be too rough for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 50s report smoother, softer-looking skin and a more youthful appearance with continued use, though this is described as a subjective impression rather than a measured change.

concerns.aging: Several long-term users in their 50s report smoother skin and a more youthful appearance with continued use; one who attributes her lack of wrinkles partly to the product still notes crow's feet and under-eye bags.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin mostly report the scrub does not strip or dry out their skin compared with harsher exfoliants they have used, including relief for occasional winter dryness; a couple of reviewers with dry, flaky skin instead found the particles too sharp and described the product as stripping.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the scrub does not trigger redness, and a couple with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin say redness looked less noticeable with regular use, though one credits the improvement to combining the scrub with a prescription treatment rather than the scrub alone.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers with reactive skin, one managing eczema and another whose skin had become so sensitized that even moisturizer stung, report this scrub did not cause burning or irritation, unlike other products they had tried.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of dark spots and a more even skin tone with continued use, including specific mentions of melasma and post-acne marks lightening over weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne- or blemish-prone, including several with oily or combination skin, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin with regular use, with specific mentions of cleared blackheads and no new breakouts even after months of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin says the scrub leaves a residual moisturized feel rather than the fully oil-free finish she wanted, while another reports it visibly tightens and reduces the appearance of large pores.

aspects.libelle: Sharp, coarse grit in some batches
Gentle, finely-milled grit for most users
Formula, color and texture vary between batches
Tube or cap often arrives damaged or leaking
Unusual dark color and earthy scent
Long-lasting; a little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Terrible texture. STOP: has large sharp nut particles
extraits.texte: How does a product like this even past the approval process? Reading it was a clay I was excited because I’m forever looking for super fine grain exfoliants having dry flaky skin but not wanting to scratch the skin surface. Wow was I wrong believing this to be a nice smooth clay texture. See pic..I smeared some on a plate. In fact it’s a runny watery mess with a slightly thickening emulsifier added. And then these big suuuper sharp scratchy exfoliants particles. I read the back and I was horrified to see it’s ground nut shells. What!? We all know you can’t do that! I am all for wanting to stay natural, but that’s the trick with exfoliants… Only certain fine clay products fit the bill of superfine exfoliation that minimizes microtears on the skin surface. Anything large like ground nuts in godforsaken drugstore brands that also crush up natural particles scratch the crap out of your skin! You can feel it! I was horrified when I tried this product and quickly rinsed it away. Not to mention the tube is cheap plastic… Arrived cracked at the edges near the pressed end. Even though the shipping box was in good shape. So it leaked within the bag and I lost some product. Amazon gave me a credit because of the leak since this item is not returnable. But I’m so unimpressed with the product it’s going in the trash.

extraits.titre: It has a lot of grit like beach sand.
extraits.texte: I ordered this Acure Brightening Facial Scrub to use as a daily face scrubber. I have oily skin and wanted a cleanser that got my skin practically squeaky clean by washing off all the oil. The Sea Kelp & French Green Clay smell nice, but it doesn't get my skin feeling as clean as I would like. My face feels like it has some moisturizer on it after washing. That might be good for some people, but it doesn't work for me. Also, this scrub has some grit! Don't push too hard while scrubbing. The first time I used it, I pushed too hard. It felt like I was scrubbing my face with wet beach sand. I will not purchase again.

extraits.titre: Amazing for My Super Sensitive Skin!
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin, so finding a face scrub that doesn’t leave my skin feeling irritated, dry, or uncomfortable can be really difficult. I honestly wasn’t expecting much from this one because it’s so affordable, but I’ve been genuinely impressed with it. After using it, my skin feels incredibly soft and smooth, and I love how clean and refreshed my face feels afterward. One of the biggest things I noticed is that my skin looks calmer and the redness seems much less noticeable after I use it. It exfoliates my skin well without feeling overly harsh, which is especially important for me because my skin reacts very easily to new products. I also really appreciate that I don’t have to spend a lot of money to get such good results. I’ve tried more expensive skincare products that I didn’t enjoy nearly as much as this one. It has definitely become one of those products I look forward to using in my skincare routine. If you have sensitive skin like me and struggle to find an affordable scrub that leaves your skin feeling smooth without making it feel irritated, I think this one is absolutely worth trying. I would genuinely repurchase this again and again!

extraits.titre: Answer to my sensitive skin prayers!
extraits.texte: I received a small trial bottle of this scrub in a kit and fell in love! I have always only been able to use regular dial antibacterial soap on my sensitive skin. I have combination (sometimes oily sometimes dry) skin depending on the weather. This scrub has changed my life! I use it every other day and it softens my skin and helps my skin appear more youthful! I started using this scrub after Christmas and people can NOT BELIEVE I am 35!! YES! they freak out when I tell them I am not 24! HAHA! Seriously, I hear it from everyone how young I look and how vibrant my skin is! It is all because of this scrub! My skin is no longer dull from harsh, chemical soaps. I tried EVERYTHING! Expensive washes and toners and moisturizers...you name it...I have tried it!! This is the only scrub that has not broken me out. I love it and I know you will too!!

I’ve tried several products to brighten my skin and gently remove dry skin cells for daily use, and this one stands out! The Acure Facial Scrub not only fulfills its purpose but also leaves my face feeling incredibly fresh and smooth, like butter, without the dryness I experienced from more abrasive scrubs in the past. I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my melasma, especially on my forehead. While I also use a serum, I believe every skincare routine needs an excellent scrub to prep the skin, and this product does just that. I’ll definitely continue purchasing this scrub in the future.

I was a but weary at first that the facial scrub might be too abrasive. However, I struggle with acne and build up due to dry and dead skin and I needed something a bit more abrasive than ny current exfoliate to add into my skin care routine. THIS IS IT! My face feels amazing after use - it was just enough abrasion without damage. Will keep using this several times per week as recommended.

extraits.titre: I didn’t think it would work this well!
extraits.texte: I was prescribed a topical medication for my rosacea, but it wasn’t until I added this scrub that my skin really started to look better! I received the ‘new’ formula, and it works great (:
